profiles.Summary: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 is a demanding open-world shooter built on Unreal Engine 5 that significantly exceeds the Steam Deck's GPU capabilities, requiring aggressive upscaling and low settings to reach even 30 fps. With no Deck-specific reports available, profiles are estimated from PC minimum requirements and hardware comparisons, and real-world performance may vary considerably.
profiles.BasisNote: No Steam Deck or ProtonDB Deck-specific reports were available; profiles are estimated from the PC minimum spec (GTX 1060 6 GB for 30 fps at Low/1080p) versus the Deck's approximate GTX 1050 Ti GPU class. On your first run, check frame pacing in an outdoor open-world area and adjust FSR quality and TDP accordingly — the game may run worse or better than estimated depending on Proton compatibility and shader cache state.

MaxBattery.Notes: Use FSR 2 in Performance mode within the game rather than relying solely on the Deck overlay scaling for best image quality. Keep TDP at 8 W and GPU clock pinned to reduce power draw; expect occasional dips below 30 fps in dense outdoor areas.

KnownIssues: Steam Deck is officially listed as Unsupported, meaning crashes or launcher issues are possible
UE5 Lumen and Nanite features are extremely GPU-heavy and will tank performance if not disabled
16 GB shared RAM (split between CPU and GPU) may cause stuttering in memory-intensive open-world areas
Shader compilation stutter is common on first launch with Proton; expect hitching until shaders are cached

MaxPerformance.Notes: Running at full 15 W TDP with GPU maxed out; FSR 2 Ultra Performance is needed to approach 40 fps but image quality will be noticeably softer. Sustained 40 fps is not guaranteed in all areas — drop the frame cap to 30 if outdoor scenes cause persistent throttling.

Optimal.Notes: FSR Balanced at a 1024x640 render target gives a noticeable image quality improvement over Performance mode while still keeping the GPU within reach of a stable 30 fps cap. Medium textures and effects add atmosphere without a heavy GPU cost; shadows and GI stay low as they are the biggest performance drains in UE5.

profiles.Summary: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 is a demanding Unreal Engine 5 open-world shooter that significantly exceeds the Steam Deck's GPU capabilities, requiring heavy use of FSR upscaling and low settings to reach playable frame rates around 30 fps. The game is rated Unsupported on Steam Deck, but ProtonDB gold reports suggest it can run with the right Proton version and settings tweaks.
profiles.BasisNote: No Steam Deck-specific reports were available; profiles are estimated from the PC minimum requirements (GTX 1060 6 GB target for 30 fps at Low/1080p) scaled against the Deck's RDNA 2 GPU (roughly GTX 1050 Ti class) and the game's UE5 engine demands. On first run, check frame rate in an outdoor open-world area and during combat — if you see sustained drops below 25 fps even on Low, the game may not be reliably playable on Deck at this time.

MaxBattery.Notes: Render at 960x600 internally with FSR Performance upscaling to stretch to 1280x800; the 9 W TDP cap and pinned GPU clock help keep heat and battery drain manageable. Expect occasional dips below 30 fps during heavy combat or dense outdoor areas.

KnownIssues: Game is officially 'Unsupported' on Steam Deck — some features or stability issues may persist
High RAM and VRAM demands from UE5 may cause stuttering or hitching when streaming open-world areas
Shader compilation stutter is common on first launch and when entering new zones
Controller support is listed as only 'Partial', so some UI elements or menus may require touchscreen or mouse input

MaxPerformance.Notes: Targeting 40 fps at 40 Hz refresh gives the smoothest feel this hardware can realistically sustain; full 15 W TDP with GPU at max clock is needed to approach this target. Drop to FSR Balanced or lower Shadow/Foliage if you see sustained dips below 35 fps in dense outdoor zones.
